newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai aims at 10 bln yuan nuclear power sales.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai aims at 10 bln yuan nuclear power sales.

text.p: Shanghai, China's biggest city and its economic hub, aims to wrack up annual sales of nuclear power facilities of up to 10 billion yuan ($1.2 billion) by 2000, making it a pillar industry, the Liberation Daily said on Wednesday.
Shanghai now has the capacity to produce facilities for generating 300,000 to one million kilowatts a year, having developed the industry since the 1960s, the newspaper said.

The city produced half of the nuclear power facilities for the first stage of the Qinshan nuclear power plant in east China's Zhejiang province, which has an annual capacity of 300,000 kilowatts, the newspaper said.
The city will produce 450 million yuan worth of facilities for the plant's second stage, it said, but gave no further details.
